description: Abidjan (Ivory Coast) - Urban Land Use / Land Cover (LULC) 2005 & 2018 (Larger Urban Area and Core City Area) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Physical features", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). Land Use / Land Cover (LULC) information product over Abidjan (Ivory Coast) contains spatial explicit information on different land use and land cover occurring in the Larger Urban Area and Core City Area of the City of Abidjan for past (2005) and current (2018) dates. Coverage: Abidjan. It has 10 files in SHP ZIP, PDF, HTML. The portal files it under Physical features. The portal gives 2019 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
